summary: The preparer responds to individual concerns by directing the commenter to revised sections of the Final EIS (e.g., Sections 1.4.1, 3.2.2.2, 3.2.2.3, 8.2.2, Tables 8-2 and 8-3, Section 8.2.9, and Section 9), noting that quantitative data on conservation alternatives is lacking, that the Production Cost Computer Program accounts for fossil-fueled pumpback, and that Section 9 of the Final EIS addresses the consequences of denying the license application.
